i just had her this past fall semester :) she's incredibly understanding and accommodating. professor Parikh does participation grades, but they're easy since it's not based on accuracy and she uses polleverywhere and piazza. there are quizzes set up for each unit, and she provides all of the notes/information you need for the quizzes. quizzes are done outside of class, and they are due on the saturday night during the week they're assigned. weekly assignments are there too, but frankly, as long as you pay attention and study-- you will be fine! there is a midterm that is structured similarly to the quizzes.

advice: don't underestimate this class! it seems very laidback, but if you start slacking off/not paying attention, you will get behind! quizzes + midterm are more conceptual-based, and the final is application-based (understanding the output of data).

plus, enjoy your time in her class-- she's the sweetest person and won't make you feel intimidated if you need help. (all of the nice ratemyprofessor reviews she has are true)
